jobs.description:
**About Teleport**

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.

We are looking for a Field Marketing Manager to lead and execute regional and partner-led event programs that drive pipeline and revenue across the U.S. This role reports to the Senior Channel Marketing Manager and works cross-functionally with Sales, Channel Marketing, Global Campaigns, and Partner Marketing to align regional strategies with go-to-market goals.

The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic environment and brings a strong understanding of field marketing execution, partner and channel collaboration, and event-driven demand generation. If you’re self-motivated, coachable, and ready to drive meaningful impact in a cutting-edge cybersecurity company, we’d love to meet you.

### **What You Will Do**

* Own and execute regional and partner-led field marketing programs that drive pipeline and revenue, including executive roundtables, webinars, co-branded events, and strategic partner activations.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Channel, and Partner Marketing to align programs with GTM goals and ensure measurable impact on pipeline generation and acceleration.
* Support the execution and logistics of Teleport-hosted and third-party events (virtual, in-person, hybrid), ensuring seamless execution and integration into broader campaign strategy.
* Lead and scale field initiatives in collaboration with key technology and channel partners—delivering joint experiences that engage target accounts and create shared value.
* Serve as a strategic marketing partner to sales leadership, supporting territory planning and creating tailored programs that support early-stage pipeline and late-stage deal acceleration.
* Leverage campaign, content, and product marketing teams to ensure programs resonate with target personas across the buyer journey—from developer to decision-maker.
* Analyze, report, and optimize field programs based on ROI, lead quality, pipeline influence, and conversion metrics; share learnings and recommendations to scale what works.
* Create repeatable toolkits and “events-in-a-box” playbooks that empower sales and partners to activate field marketing motions globally.

### **Qualifications**

* 4–6 years of experience in field marketing, demand generation, or integrated campaigns at B2B SaaS companies, preferably supporting both PLG and enterprise sales motions.
* Demonstrated success in building and scaling field marketing programs that deliver measurable pipeline impact.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to balance strategic thinking with tactical execution.
* Experience with partner marketing and executing joint programs with technology or cloud partners.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce, marketing automation platforms (e.g., Hubspot or Marketo), and ABM tools (e.g., 6sense or Demandbase).
* Comfortable collaborating closely with Sales and CS teams; you know how to translate GTM priorities into marketing programs that work.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging to technical and business audiences.
* Data-driven mindset with a bias toward experimentation, performance tracking, and continuous improvement.
* Willingness to travel (up to 40%) for event execution and on-site collaboration.

Bonus Points: Familiarity with infrastructure, security, or developer tools—and a passion for bringing technical communities together through experiences.

**Why Teleport**

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.

**The Benefits**

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

* Extensive health coverage
* Annual expense budget
* Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge
* Investment in your future with retirement savings plans
* Professional development opportunities

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**Your mission at Mercanis**

We are looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to help scale Mercanis's presence globally. This is a performance- and pipeline-driven role: you will own a number, not just a set of activities. You'll sit at the intersection of outbound and inbound, making sure both teams are aligned on target accounts and pipeline goals — and you will own the channels and campaigns that drive it. The initial focus is on the UK & DACH, and then globally, so you will have room to test what works beyond the core. Reporting to VP of Marketing, working in collaboration with Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Design, and Content.

**Your Responsibilities on this role**

* Drive market expansion in the UK & Ireland region — build the regional campaigns and channel mix to grow pipeline in the market we're actively scaling
* Grow Mercanis's market presence in the DACH market — build awareness and demand generation among procurement and operations decision-makers
* Own a monthly pipeline number across your markets, and be directly accountable for hitting it
* Be the connector between the outbound and inbound teams, aligning with the sales team on target accounts and lead handoff
* Own and optimize paid acquisition across LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and other channels— managing budget, targeting, and creative testing against hard pipeline and CAC targets
* Brief and ship SEO-driven landing pages and content to improve organic visibility and inbound lead quality, in a collaboration with the content writer
* Plan and run campaigns targeting sign-ups for events, webinars, in a collaboration with the field marketer
* Build and own full-funnel reporting and attribution in HubSpot (MQLs, pipeline, ROI), so we always know exactly what's driving pipeline — and iterate fast based on what the data shows & sales team’s feedback
* Partner with Sales to sharpen lead-qualification criteria for each market
* Run a continuous test-and-learn cadence — prioritize experiments by expected impact on pipeline and CAC, and kill fast what doesn't perform
* Run experiments into new markets beyond the UK & DACH — small-scale tests on channels, messaging, and demand to see where it's worth doubling down next

**Role requirements**

* 5+ years of growth or performance marketing experience in B2B SaaS or tech, ideally at a fast-growing company, with a track record of hitting pipeline and revenue targets
* Knowledge of HubSpot for campaign execution, lead scoring, and reporting
* Knowledge of LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and Meta — hands-on experience planning, running, and optimizing paid campaigns against CAC and pipeline targets
* Experience writing SEO briefs and working with content/design to produce landing pages that convert
* Comfort working cross-functionally with outbound (SDR) and inbound teams to align on ICP and lead handoff & lead feedback
* A performance-marketing mindset — you think in CAC, pipeline velocity, and ROI, and you're comfortable owning a number
* A data-driven mindset — comfortable reading funnel metrics (MQL/SQL/pipeline/CAC) and turning insights into action fast
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving fast in a scale-up environment
* Nice to have: experience growing a market in the UK and DACH region, background in procurement, supply chain, or other enterprise B2B software

**Why to join us here at Mercanis?**

* A high-ownership role at a fast-growing, AI-native procurement scale-up
* A hybrid of onsite collaboration in London or Berlin with a close-knit, international team
* Competitive salary and equity package
* Budget for learning, tools, and professional development
* The chance to shape growth marketing strategy as we expand globally, starting with the UK & DACH

Most money apps talk at you. Cleo talks back

We're not building another finance app. We're building the world's first AI financial assistant, one that actually understands your money and makes you better at it, and we're changing the world's relationship with money in the process For everyone, whatever their background or balance.

The proof: profitable, fast-growing, a unicorn with over $300M in ARR, and millions of people who now feel differently about their money.

We love original thinkers who challenge the status quo. We move fast, tell the truth, and there's nowhere to hide from good work here. If that excites you more than it scares you, you'll fit right in.

Follow us on LinkedIn for new features and the occasional roast

**Meet the team**  
Hi I'm Chris the Chief Unit Economics Officer at Cleo. I care about revenue growth and, importantly, the economics behind it - which means I focus on everything from how people find us through to making the unit economics actually work.

We cover parts of marketing, product and commercial - a team of ~40 people across Growth and Performance Marketing. It's a broad org, but it centres on one clear goal: grow the company efficiently.

You'll thrive here if you structure your thoughts and plans, base your ideas on facts more than opinion, would rather own a number end to end than sit neatly inside a process, and can always see the next opportunity.  
  
**About the Role**  
We're looking for a **Growth Marketing Manager** to join our Performance Growth Marketing team, reporting into our Growth Marketing Lead. You'll scale our programmatic and affiliate channels, optimising for CPA and user quality, and make sure we scale what's genuinely incremental and cut what isn't.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Launch and scale campaigns across performance DSPs, with a clean read on incremental impact
* Own the day-to-day: pacing to daily budgets, bid and CPA caps, monitoring and fixing tech issues and conversion optimisation
* Optimise targeting, inventory, creative and bidding against CPA and quality targets, not just volume
* Vet new partners before launch: get their source whitelists (apps and SSPs) and run overlap analysis against inventory we already buy
* Support with diversifying the partner mix beyond aggregators into content, creators, loyalty and ambassadors
* Support with the commission redesign, moving partners from flat CPA to value-based payouts (decile, subscription)
* Monitor partner traffic for quality and fraud, and push commission reversals where needed
* Support with partner comms management - be the first point of contact for affiliates
* Own channel reporting: daily anomaly checks, weekly updates and MTD pacing vs plan
* Run creative tests across partners and feed what we learn into the next brief
* Keep attribution and cost data clean: channel taxonomy, partner spend ingestion, reconciling AppsFlyer vs Count
* Work with the AX team on incrementality testing, so we scale what's incremental and cut what isn't, and with AE/GMP teams to improve eventing and trackin
* Build the commercial case for every scale, pause or new partner decision, and come with a clear recommendation grounded in team KPIs

**What We're Looking For**

* Hands-on programmatic buying experience across DSPs (The Trade Desk, DV360 or performance DSPs), incl. PMPs, deals and ad servers, with a record of hitting targets
* Strong command of an MMP (AppsFlyer or similar): postbacks, partner integrations, attribution windows, SKAN and privacy settings
* Affiliate platform experience (Impact.com, Rakuten), incl. commission structures and sub-ID tracking
* Proven experience negotiating with partners on pricing, payout models and budgets, and holding them to account on performance, including the difference between target and fixed CPAs
* A strong grasp of unit economics (CPA, LTV, payback), optimising for user quality while balancing volume
* Strong data fluency: pulls and checks their own data in SQL or a BI tool (Count, Mode, Looker), and uses AI to automate the repetitive stuff
* Comfort making budget calls and backing them up with numbers
* The bbility to turn messy data from different sources into clear next steps
* A deep understanding of incrementality and test design, and healthy scepticism of platform-reported numbers
* Nice to have: value-based bidding or pLTV models

**What we offer**
-----------------

We offer benefits package built to support you in and out of work. Benefits vary by country and include meaningful equity, comprehensive health insurance, mental health support, a paid one-month sabbatical after four years, a learning & development platform, pension or retirement contributions, and location-specific leave entitlements.  
  
For the full breakdown on what's available in your location, visit our Candidate Hub

**What Matters**
----------------

Cleo's mission is to change the world's relationship with money. We can't do that without building a brilliant, genuinely diverse team - and making sure our hiring process gives everyone a fair shot, running a fair and transparent recruitment process in which every candidate is considered on their merits.

We're glad to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process. If there's anything we can do to support you in showing us your best, please let your recruiter or one of the team know.

We may use AI-assisted tools during the recruitment process to take support the team in different ways like taking notes or referring back to conversations. They do not replace the team and all applications are reviewed by a Cleo employee thoroughly!

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Associate - Global Markets (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Voy is a healthcare platform led by clinicians. We support people managing long-term health conditions with treatment plans backed by real evidence.  
  
Founded in 2018, we started as MANUAL, focusing on hair loss, weight loss and men's health. As we grew, we realised we could help more people. In 2025, we became Voy and expanded into more areas of health, including female hair loss, testosterone, menopause, dermatology and diagnostics with Do Health.  
  
Today, Voy has around 750,000 active customers and has treated more than 2 million people since we began. We work across the UK, Germany, Brazil and India to make a new future of healthcare a reality. We're approaching $1bn in ARR and have grown more than 100% year on year, every year since inception. At Voy, we let the evidence do the talking. In a published study of over 100,000 people, those who reached 12 months in the Voy programme and stayed engaged lost up to 24% of their body weight.  
  
Our vision is simple: to make 100 years of healthy living within reach for everybody. Our mission is to bring quality care to everyone, at scale.

#### **The Opportunity**

Since launching in 2019, Voy's been one of Europe's fastest growing consumer health companies. A crucial component to that growth has been our influencer marketing and Social Media presence. As we're establishing more markets around Europe and expand our Intl. Growth team, you have the chance to shape our influencer- and Social Media strategy in EU, from the ground up collaborating closely with creators across heath, sports and lifestyle across channels such as Instagram, TikTok and Youtube.

  

#### **What You'll Be Doing**

* **Own the influencer marketing channel:** Take responsibility for planning, executing and developing our influencer marketing activities across our European markets, and set clear priorities based on our growth goals.
* **Build strategic creator partnerships:** Find relevant creators on platforms like Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, negotiate with them yourself, and build long-term partnerships with strong brand and performance potential.
* **Source UGC creators:** Identify and collaborate with UGC creators across our markets to produce authentic, high-performing content for paid and organic campaigns.
* **Manage organic social media:** Help plan and manage our organic social media presence in the different markets, keeping content relevant locally and consistent with the brand.
* **Work with local partners:** Manage relationships with local agencies and translators so that campaigns and content work for each market and culture.
* **Drive performance and scale:** Analyse campaigns against the right KPIs, spot the formats, creators and audiences that work early, and turn those insights into clear actions to optimise and scale.
* **Shape campaign strategy and creative:** Develop compelling campaign concepts and briefs, understand which content works on what platform and in which market, and work closely with creators on content that feels authentic and performs well.
* **Find new growth opportunities:** Keep track of the creator and social media market, test new platforms, formats and niches, and turn what you learn into new growth ideas.
* **Plan budgets and forecasts:** Plan budgets, judge investments on expected and actual performance, and put resources where they'll have the biggest impact.
* **Work across teams:** Work closely with the General Manager of the international growth team, the Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing, Brand, Creative and other teams to share learnings across channels and keep the brand and growth strategy consistent.

  

#### **What You Need To Shine**

* **Relevant experience:** 2-4 years of experience in influencer, creator or content marketing, including campaigns or creator portfolios you've owned yourself.
* **International mindset:** You have worked across several markets or countries and enjoy adapting to different cultures and platforms.
* **Strategic and hands-on:** You can build a strategy and are just as happy to get into the operational detail and execute it yourself.
* **Performance know-how:** You're confident with KPIs and understand how to judge influencer marketing by reach, conversion, CAC/CPA, ROI and long-term brand value.
* **Commercial sense and negotiation skills:** You can judge a partnership's potential, allocate budgets sensibly and negotiate terms with confidence.
* **Creator and content expertise:** You understand how Instagram, TikTok and YouTube work and have a good sense of which creators, messages and content formats really move an audience.
* **Analytical approach:** You work in a structured, data-driven way, question results and turn learnings into clear next steps.
* **Languages:** Fluent English. Additional European languages are a plus.
* **Growth mindset:** You enjoy a fast-paced environment, take ownership and test new approaches instead of relying only on existing playbooks.
* **Nice to have:** Experience managing agency relationships, content creation and stakeholder management; Experience with performance-driven influencer marketing, with TikTok as an acquisition channel, and at a D2C, health, beauty or fast-growing digital company.

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Macrobond is a leading provider of global economic and financial data and technology for investment professionals. Our customers include over 900 firms spanning the buyside, sell side, corporate and academic sectors.

Our platform, rich in intellectual property and supported by a rapidly expanding global team, ensures we remain at the forefront of our industry. With the backing of Francisco Partners, a prominent global tech investment firm, we operate as a truly international company. Our headquarters are based in London, with key offices in Gothenburg, Malmö, Poland, Lisbon, Hong Kong, and New York.

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a commercially minded, hands-on Integrated Marketing Manager to join our growing Enterprise Marketing function.

Reporting to the Director of Enterprise Marketing, you will be responsible for the planning, execution and optimisation of integrated marketing programmes across three core pillars: Demand Generation, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), and Global Events & Conferences.

Working closely with Sales, Sales Development and the wider Marketing team, you will bring our global Enterprise Marketing strategy to life through coordinated campaigns that drive audience engagement, qualified pipeline and commercial growth.

This is an exciting opportunity for a proactive B2B marketer who enjoys taking ownership, managing multiple initiatives and getting involved in all aspects of campaign delivery within a growing, international business.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Integrated campaign management**

* Plan, execute and optimise integrated marketing campaigns across priority markets, audience segments and channels.
* Translate marketing objectives into actionable campaign plans, coordinating messaging, content, channels, deliverables and timelines.
* Manage the integrated campaign calendar, ensuring alignment with commercial priorities and regional opportunities.
* Coordinate internal stakeholders, external agencies and suppliers to deliver campaigns on time and within budget.

**Demand generation**

* Execute multi-channel demand generation campaigns, including email marketing, webinars, content syndication and lead nurturing programmes.
* Work closely with Sales and Sales Development to support effective lead management, follow-up and conversion.
* Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement, lead generation and conversion rates.

**Account-Based Marketing (ABM)**

* Support the execution of Macrobond's ABM strategy through targeted marketing programmes across priority accounts and audience segments.
* Collaborate with Sales and Sales Development to activate account-specific campaigns and support pipeline creation and opportunity acceleration.
* Coordinate relevant content, messaging and marketing touchpoints to engage target accounts throughout the buying journey.

**Global Events & Conferences**

* Manage the end-to-end delivery of industry conferences, sponsorships, proprietary events, webinars and partner-led initiatives.
* Coordinate event organisers, suppliers, logistics, budgets and internal stakeholders.
* Develop and execute pre-event, onsite and post-event marketing activities to maximise engagement, meeting generation and commercial impact.
* Track event performance and provide insights to inform future investment decisions.

**Performance measurement and reporting**

* Monitor and report on campaign performance against agreed KPIs, including lead generation, conversion rates, qualified opportunities and pipeline contribution.
* Use Salesforce and relevant marketing automation and analytics tools to track campaign effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to optimise marketing activities and contribute to the development of scalable campaign processes and best practices.

  

**What do we offer**

* Private medical insurance, inclusive of dental, vision, and hearing
* Life insurance
* Company pension scheme, with a strong employer contribution
* Gym discounts
* 25 days holiday per annum
2 Macrobond days to use per annum for volunteering  

  

**Our commitment to Diversity:**

At Macrobond, diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental to our culture and success. We are committed to fostering an environment where all individuals are respected, valued, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

By joining our team, you become part of an organization that believes diversity drives innovation and strengthens our collective performance. Apply today and be part of our ongoing journey of growth and inclusion.

#### **About Smartnumbers**

We are on a mission to stop fraud and improve customer authentication. Fraud is a huge problem affecting millions of people, it costs the UK nearly £7bn and represents 40% of all crime. Too often the solution has been to put in place cumbersome authentication processes that frustrate genuine customers, cause inefficiencies for organisations and fail to prevent fraud.  
  
We are changing this by providing organisations with real-time insight into the risk of a caller. We combine patented machine learning technology with our deep domain knowledge to prevent contact centre fraud.  
  
We recognise that we need to work together to fight fraud, that is why we have fostered strategic partnerships with leading global organisations like Amazon, BT, Genesys and NICE. Together, we protect the UK's largest retail banks, investment banks and emergency services. We also believe in developing our people and developing high performing teams.

#### **What you'll be working on**

We are rapidly expanding our product offerings and becoming a multi-product organisation, serving new markets and geographies, increasing the need for cohesive, valuable and structured messaging for a wider and more diverse set of buyers and use cases.  
  
You will own the product story for each of our propositions, keep it true to the product, and make sure our sellers and partners can tell it well. The types of areas you'll look at include:

  

* Positioning and messaging - building the story for each product and each buyer with Sales and Marketing, and testing it with sellers before it is final
* Competitive insight - understanding what our competitors build and why, and turning that into battlecards, objection handling and win/loss reviews that sharpen how we sell
* Launches - planning and preparing launches with the product managers, including the launch kit and internal readiness
* Sales and partner enablement - pitch decks, demo stories, playbooks and training for our sellers, and train-the-trainer material for partners such as BT
* Proof - case studies, ROI stories and references built to the standard large enterprises expect, with claims that stand up to scrutiny
* Market insight and thought leadership - buyer research, bringing what you learn back into product decisions, and writing about new use cases, market trends, what our data shows and what new regulation means for our customers.

**How you'll work**  
  
This is a hands-on role. You'll write the messaging, build the battlecards and prepare the launches yourself, as there is no team or agency to hand work to. You'll report to the Chief Product & Strategy Officer and work most closely with our product managers across our product portfolio, as well as Sales and Marketing.  
  
We're a product-led organisation. We build our understanding of the market from evidence gathered across many sources: sales conversations, customers, events, research and our own data. Go-to-market is shared between Product and Sales, and you'll be the link between the two. That means explaining where the product is going and why, taking feedback from the field seriously, and changing the story when the evidence says it should change.  
  
We're a start-up that sells to some of the UK's largest enterprise businesses, so our material needs to stand alongside much bigger suppliers. You'll also have room to choose your own topics, such as new use cases, new markets and changes in regulation, while staying closely aligned with our wider product strategy and roadmap.  
  
We're a close-knit company so there'll be plenty of exposure to the rest of the business, including executives.

#### **What you'll need for the role**

Smartnumbers values diversity of experience. Candidates should have a strong combination of several of the following skills, competencies and experience:

  

* Competitive insight - You've built and run a competitive programme in B2B security, fraud, identity or communications. You can explain a competitor's strategy, not just its feature list, and you've used that insight to change a product decision or a sales approach
* Technical understanding - You've marketed technical products to technical buyers and can explain how a product works, and where its limits are, in plain English. Telephony or contact centre experience helps but isn't required
* Writing for more than one buyer - You've positioned one platform to different buyers, changing the message while keeping the product facts the same
* Claims that stand up - You've turned customer and product data into proof points, worked with legal or compliance reviewers, and know what not to say
* Shared ownership - You've worked as a peer to sales leaders, debating and agreeing positions without formal authority. You seek feedback early and change your view when the evidence supports it
* Launch and partner experience - You've led B2B launches from start to finish, kept them on track when dates moved, and built enablement for resellers, telcos or contact centre platform partners
* Building from a blank page - You've been the first or only product marketer somewhere, or set up the function from scratch, and produced work to an enterprise standard without a large team behind you

  
How you work with others matters just as much. We look for people who are curious, open to challenge, collaborative and low-ego, and honest about what they don't know.  
  
It would be a bonus if you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, or have experience with industry analysts or HubSpot.

#### **What we can offer you**

As well as a competitive salary of £80,000 to £90,000 per annum, depending on experience, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package, covering a variety of areas, both professional and personal. These benefits include:

  

* Hybrid working style, with the expectation of two days in the office (with a great City of London office base!)
* Family friendly benefits including paid parental leave policies
